verdict: one Critical (architecture) + four Major; codec subset is separable and implementable

findings.summary: Two-consumer capture is unimplementable on current machinery: trust.py enforces exactly one CAPTURED per published stream (_require_head -> _p4_ledger._require_unclaimed; _validate_capture_request legacy/P4 cross-refusal). The F3 hierarchy requires the data root to be CAPTURED twice (manifest-producer data_captured_receipt AND ReplayRun replay-data receipt).

ordered_envelope_digests/envelope_count are never bound to the data capture's actual members; 'digests are supplied inputs' is a scope dodge that leaves the tape DATA unverified, so the composed tape can replay arbitrary envelopes.

data_capture_root digest semantics undefined: trust.py has no single root sha256 (it has root_ref/root_id/snapshot_version/document_sha256/node/output/purpose + member_manifest_sha256); the contract permits binding members only, not root provenance.

The composed-tape seam's binding to opaque F4 handles is asserted, not pinned; an implementation could accept caller-supplied equal-looking digest strings instead of broker-resolved VerifiedCapture/CAPTURED-receipt handles.
source_rank_policy_sha256 step-4 is a 'synthetic fixture pin', never required to equal the data capture's consumed source_roster_policy_sha256 nor the frozen execution-block pin.
codec accepts the all-zeros placeholder digest ('0'*64) and 'self'; trust.py's _require_sha256 refuses both.
ComposedReplayTape opacity is test-asserted, not pinned as a no-public-constructor/_Opaque invariant.
replay consumer run identity is refused only against the data producer run, not the manifest-producer consumer run.
field-count muddle: 'seven inputs' vs 'eight/fixed fields' vs 'exact 9-field'.
envelope_count accepts JSON boolean true (isinstance(True,int) is True).

disposition: CRIT-1 and MAJ-2..MAJ-8 concern the composed-tape verification seam, which requires multi-consumer capture (one published root captured by two distinct consumer documents) that the current F4 v1 + P4 machinery does not support. Re-scope to slice 2a = the CapturedReplayTape.v1 codec only (self-contained, implementable), fixing MIN-6/NIT-9/NIT-10; the composed-tape verification becomes slice 2b, gated on the multi-consumer-capture architecture decision (0164).
